ActionButtons.docstring: A GUI component for creating Start, Stop, and Snapshot buttons.

StyleTabManager.docstring: A GUI component that manages style selection with categorization using tabs.

WebcamThread.docstring:
A QThread that captures video frames using PyAV, applies the chosen style,
and publishes them to a virtual camera with pyvirtualcam.

WebcamApp.docstring:
Main GUI application that manages device selection, style parameters,
and the start/stop logic for the webcam processing thread.

DeviceSelector.docstring: A GUI component for selecting input devices.

SettingsManager.docstring: Manages application settings with validation and error handling.
Manages application settings with proper error handling and logging.

BaseDeviceManager.docstring: Abstract base class for device management.

DeviceManagerFactory.docstring: Factory for creating platform-specific device managers.

MainWindow.docstring: Main application window that integrates all components.

StyleManager.docstring: Manages style loading and instantiation with variant support and proper error handling.

AccessibilityManager.docstring: Manages accessibility features for the GUI application.

V2MainWindow.docstring: V2 Main application window with modern layout and accessibility features.

ActionButtons.docstring: Widget containing action buttons for controlling the webcam and taking snapshots.

HelpAboutDialog.docstring: Help and About dialog for the application.

HelpButton.docstring: A help button that opens the help dialog.

DeviceSelector.docstring: Widget for selecting video input devices.

BitwiseOperation.docstring:
Abstract base class for all bitwise operations.
Provides common functionality for generating masks and validating images.

V2StyleSelector.docstring: V2 Style Selector with broader tabs and dropdown variants.

PreviewArea.docstring: Real-time preview area for webcam feed with style effects.

WebcamService.docstring: Service for managing webcam input and virtual camera output.

BlurStyle.docstring: A style that applies a Gaussian blur to the image.

StyleTabManager.docstring: Widget for managing style tabs and parameters.

Style.docstring: Abstract base class for all styles with variant/mode support.

Threshold.docstring: Applies a binary threshold to the input image.

Solarize.docstring: A style that applies a solarize effect to the input image.

AdvancedCartoon.docstring:
A style that applies an advanced cartoon effect to the image with refined edge detection,
smoothing, optional color quantization, dynamic lighting, texture overlays, and AI-assisted
parameter optimization.

Cartoon.docstring:
A style that applies an improved cartoon effect to the image with refined edge detection,
bilateral filtering, and optional color quantization.

PencilSketchwithColor.docstring:
A style that mimics a colored pencil drawing with a light, semi-monochrome background
and subtle color shading.

AdvancedCartoonAnime.docstring:
An extended style that applies a stylized anime/isekai effect by enhancing edges,
boosting colors, posterizing the image, and optionally applying bloom and texture overlays.

EdgeDetection.docstring: A style that applies edge detection using the Canny method.

AdvancedEdgeDetection.docstring:
A style that applies advanced edge detection with color customization and glow effects.
Supports Canny, Sobel, and Laplacian methods.

OilPainting.docstring: Applies an oil painting effect to the image.

CartoonWholeImage.docstring:
A style that applies a cartoon/illustration effect across the entire image.
This pipeline does not preserve the face as normal; everything is stylized.

PencilSketch.docstring: A style that creates a pencil sketch effect on live webcam feeds.

LineArt.docstring: A style that applies a line art effect using edge detection.

Stippling.docstring: A style that applies a stippled effect to the image.

SepiaVibrant.docstring: Applies a sepia filter and enhances the vibrancy of colors in the image.

SketchStyle.docstring:
Unified Sketch style that consolidates multiple sketch variants into a single class.
Supports Pencil, Advanced, and Color modes.

SketchAndColor.docstring: A style that combines a pencil sketch effect with color blending.

BrightnessOnly.docstring: Adjusts the brightness of the image.

ContrastOnly.docstring: Adjusts the contrast of the image.

ColorBalance.docstring: Adjusts the color balance of an image by modifying the blue, green, and red channels.

Watercolor.docstring: Applies a watercolor effect to the image.

CartoonStyle.docstring:
Unified Cartoon style that consolidates multiple cartoon variants into a single class.
Supports Basic, Advanced, Advanced2, and WholeImage modes.

VibrantColor.docstring: Enhances the vibrancy of colors in the image by increasing saturation.

Negative.docstring: Fully inverts the colors of the image, creating a negative effect.

InvertColors.docstring: Inverts the colors of an image.

Glitch.docstring: Applies a glitch effect by randomly shifting color channels.

InvertStyle.docstring:
Unified Invert style that consolidates multiple invert/negative variants into a single class.
Supports Colors, Filter, and Negative modes.

Mosaic.docstring: A style that applies a mosaic effect to the image by resizing down and back up.

InvertFilter.docstring: Inverts the colors of the image, creating a negative effect.

LightLeak.docstring: Adds a customizable light leak effect to the image with adjustable intensity and color.

AdvancedHalftone.docstring: Applies a halftone effect to the image with adjustable dot size and threshold.

BlackWhite.docstring: A style that converts an image to black and white based on a threshold.

ColorQuantization.docstring: Reduces the number of colors in the image using k-means clustering.

BlurMotion.docstring: Applies a motion blur effect to the image.

Halftone.docstring: Applies a halftone effect to the image with adjustable dot size and threshold.

EmbossContrast.docstring: Applies an emboss effect and adjusts the contrast of the image.

HoughLines.docstring: Detects and draws lines on the image using the Probabilistic Hough Line Transform.

CannyEdge.docstring: Detects edges in the image using the Canny edge detection algorithm.

GlowingEdges.docstring: Enhances edges in the image and adds a glowing effect.

NegativeVintage.docstring: Applies a negative vintage effect to the image with adjustable sepia intensity.

Original.docstring: The Original style applies no changes to the frame.

BaseStyleHelper.docstring: Helper class derived from Style for testing purposes.

TestConsolidatedStyles.docstring: Test the new consolidated style system with variant support.
